subject: general
question: In a row of 16 girls, when Seema was shifted by two places towards the left, she became the 7th from the left end. What was her earlier position from the right end of the row?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4159174c4e792eb55063515a3fe4656aa1b9877c5bc8f35f53ec3f4123b84d7d.png] 

Previous position of Seema from left side = 9 (shifting by two places)

Previous position of Seema from right side = 16 - 9 + 1

Previous position of Seema from right side = 8

∴ Here, Seema is 8th from the right end.

Hence, the correct answer is **"8th".**
